exposure: transcervical radiofrequency ablation guided by integrated intrauterine sonography
transcervical radiofrequency ablation of uterine fibroids
cohort: 23 women with heavy menstrual bleeding secondary to fibroids
finding: Transcervical radiofrequency ablation with the Sonata System produced substantial durable clinical benefits beyond 5 years with a low reintervention rate.
mod_finding: There was a single pregnancy occurring within the first year of treatment leading to a normal-term delivery by elective repeat cesarean section.
